summary: The patch successfully extends lowering to handle anonymous TypeScript object literals without named shapes. It correctly implements canonical field ordering for shape identity, preserves readonly/optional metadata without affecting physical layout, handles evaluation order with tempInit, and supports all required contexts (assignments, arguments, returns, nested structures, unions, optionals, records, empty objects). All new and existing tests pass.

findings.claim: In the subset-matching reuse path, 'cf.Readonly = propertyReadonly(p)' modifies a copy of the field from the range loop, not the original in c.Fields. The l.fields map gets the updated value, but c.Fields retains whatever readonly it had when first created. If a non-readonly context creates the shape first and a readonly view reuses it later, c.Fields[k].Readonly remains false. The same issue exists at line 641 in the exact-match reuse path.
findings.repro: Reverse the order in TestAnonymousObjectReadonlyAndOptional so that view() (non-readonly label) is processed before make() (readonly label). The test would fail because shape.Fields[0].Readonly would be false.
